question: What is the meaning of sourcing statements in relation to composition, information on product constituents?
description: Sourcing statements in relation to composition refer to the information regarding the raw materials or components that make up a product. This includes details such as the percentage of raw materials used, any critical materials involved, and the origin of the materials. It is essential to have accurate and transparent information on the product constituents to assess its environmental impact and circularity within the supply chain.
